facts.fact: The OSS says Mauritania has institutionalised the GMES services MISLAND-Mauritanie (land degradation monitoring) and SAQIYA-Mauritanie (irrigation management app), both hosted on national servers, with ministries including Agriculture sharing their experience of using the services at the CUCT workshop.
